answer: The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in grove, expire in karst, and pearl lists each expiry. An attacker running 65 aliases thus needs 132 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1539 identities would post 4119 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
